meta.source: Fjell theme option chosen by Jack, 27 Sep 2026; mirrors src/styles/theme.css variable names

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm stone. Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Main text on background and card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, the header bar.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: hover, selected rows, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions. Passes 4.5:1 on background, card and muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines (decorative only).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outline buttons and checkboxes: at least 3:1 on the page (3.31), cards (3.58) and grey panels (3.00). Darkened by Jack, 27 Sep.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: main buttons, links, focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marks where you are (active sidebar item) and small emphasis. Always with dark text; never for body text.

tokens.name: highlight-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Staff app sidebar and phone top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Fill of the current sidebar item, with a highlight bar on its left edge.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Void, delete, errors. Text on it is white in light, ink in dark.

tokens.name: destructive-muted
tokens.usage: Error message backgrounds.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Awaiting confirmation. Shared with Release 1; unchanged across themes.

tokens.name: status-pending-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-pending-bg.

tokens.name: status-scheduled-bg
tokens.usage: Booked in.

tokens.name: status-scheduled-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-scheduled-bg.

tokens.name: status-waiting-bg
tokens.usage: Waiting for parts.

tokens.name: status-waiting-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-waiting-bg.

tokens.name: status-hold-bg
tokens.usage: On hold, and warnings such as the offline banner.

tokens.name: status-hold-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-hold-bg.

tokens.name: status-complete-bg
tokens.usage: Ready, done, paid.

tokens.name: status-complete-ink
tokens.usage: Text on status-complete-bg.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; gap between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, sidebar items (the base radius).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: Fjell separates with soft shadow rather than hard lines.
